Shortcut.description:
Something to capture again with one tap: a server screen and the values to put in its form. Generic: clients
know nothing of what it captures. Shared by every device of the server, like charts.

color.description: One of PALETTE; null = the accent
color.title: Color

id.description: Given by the server from the label; ignored when creating
id.title: Id

mode.description: open: show the form filled in; save: send it at once
mode.title: Mode

screen.description: The server screen whose form it fills, e.g. 'capture-expense'
screen.title: Screen

values.description: Field id -> value, as the form would send it
values.title: Values
